description: Read-only code questions over bench/fixture/tiny. Every check is a literal substring or a matching file path, never a model judgement.

tasks.prompt: Find the default request timeout used by this service. Report the constant name, its value, and the exact file path that declares it.
List every environment variable that loadConfig reads, the default for each, and the file that defines them.
One backoff constant is duplicated in two modules. Name the constant and give both exact file paths.
Which source files call retry() from src/retry.ts? Exclude the module that defines it. Give exact file paths.
Which files under src/ import from errors.ts, and which error class does each one use? Give exact file paths and class names.
Describe exactly what retry() does when the final attempt fails. Cite the file, the function, and the constant that sets the default attempt count.
Where is validateConfig called from, and which error type does it throw when the port is invalid? Give exact file paths.
What does src/index.ts export? List the exported function names.
Which test asserts the default timeout, in which file, and what is the test name?

any: loads defaults when env is empty

tasks.prompt: How many attempts does request() in src/http.ts make, and where does that number come from? Cite the file and the exact expression.
